title: How a Man of God Shows Up When His Friend's Dad Dies
caption:
Some day soon, a friend is going to call and tell you his dad died.

Most guys freeze. We don't know what to say, so we send a text and stay away. He notices who came.

Go before you have words. Say less than you think. Do the job nobody hands out. And show up again in month two, when everyone else has gone home.

"Rejoice with those who rejoice, weep with those who weep." Romans 12:15

Save this for the day you need it. Send it to the brother who'd show up for you.
